attempt.reason: Initial decision for this persistent identity.

packet.goal: Maintain health and tolerable risk, understand unknowns through evidence, develop reusable capabilities, and improve personal and shared living. You may choose, revise, pause or abandon your own questions and projects.

baseline.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 4000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form.

value.name: Gather accessible material
value.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
value.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
value.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.
